name: guardrail
description: Seungho's Claude Code plugin marketplace — one add-command for both fe-rail (frontend spec→build→review→PR harness) and self-improvement (evidence-gated convention repair loop).

plugins.name: fe-rail
plugins.description: Harness dedicated to frontend projects. Supports Next.js App Router / Vite SPA + TypeScript, Tailwind v3/v4, shadcn/ui. Automates the spec→build→review→PR cycle.

plugins.name: self-improvement
plugins.description: Conventions that fix themselves — evidence-gated convention repair loop plus a budget/archive system for bloated rule docs. Stack-agnostic (FE/BE/scripts/docs).
